attempts.summary: Created an SSH host CA on node1, signed the host's ed25519 key with a 10-year certificate (principals node1, 10.100.242.10), wired sshd to present it via HostCertificate, and verified a client trusting only the CA (no pinned host key, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes) connects successfully — both before and after a full node restart with a confirmed changed boot identity.
